AC-01.detail: No unshared project or private role appears in public search.

AC-02.detail: Public surfaces show "Untitled …" for unshared projects.

AC-03.detail: Roles on unshared projects use the generic image.

AC-04.detail: Only accepted credits on shared projects are public.

AC-05.detail: Removing Kiran from Neeli Raat kept his accepted credit on the film and profile.

AC-06.detail: There is no account-deletion action in the prototype to test. The rule is written in Your data (Draft for legal review).

AC-07.detail: A credit (proposed) was created by Kiran on his own independent project. The action has no issuer check.

AC-08.detail: Credit proposed while Konark is unverified. The action has no verification check (the screen hides it).

AC-09.detail: 2 role(s) opened publicly while Konark is unverified. The action has no verification check (the screen disables it).

AC-10.detail: Held as prepared; Sana was not asked to accept.

AC-11.detail: After losing Konark access, Aditi still opened a role and issued a credit. Actions do not check membership.

AC-12.detail: Roles from blocked parties still listed in Discover: Documentary DoP (tidewater).

AC-14.detail: Messages live in per-session state, not the shared records. The retry path reuses the message id (verify by hand in EC-MSG-002).

AC-15.detail: 2 projects from one create plus a retry. Create has no request key, so a retry after a timeout makes a duplicate.

AC-17.detail: Interest was recorded on a closed role. The action does not check role status (the screen hides the button).

AC-18.detail: The filled role reopened. Reopen does not check filled versus closed (the screen offers Hire again instead).

AC-21.detail: No account-deletion or re-registration model in the prototype.

AC-22.detail: Acting personally, Aditi opened a role and added someone on Konark's Neela Akasham. Actions do not check the acting identity.

AC-23.detail: Aditi accepted her credit while acting as Konark. Accept does not check identity (the profile hides it).

AC-24.detail: A retried Interest made 2 house notifications; a re-issued credit made 2 for Sana.

AC-25.detail: There is no ownership model: membership is a list, and Your data only blocks deletion for houses created in the session. Aditi, the only member of Konark, is not blocked.
